title: Weight of the coin.
content:
​“Maangan gaye so mar rahe, mare jo maangan jaahi…”

(Those who go to beg are dying, and dead are those who beg… -Kabir)

​

She was taught early that a stretched hand is a broken spine,

That taking favors from the world will blur the sovereign line.

She knew that for a woman in this world,

charity always comes with a cage.

​Now the seals of the windows are cracking,

winter is creeping in.

The house is unkept, the bills sit heavy on the wooden table,

A quiet, suffocating mountain she no longer feels able to move.

And standing at the edge of these ruins is the man who broke the home,

Holding out a quiet coin, offering to pay the toll.

when the bond was alive, she carried her weight,

She paid the price of his presence, she managed the estate.

Now he wishes to returns as a savior,

offering cash for the breaking walls,

And the torment inside her fractures every time he calls.

​Oh, the body begs to take it.

The exhaustion is so deep.

She desperately wants to be cared for, she wants to finally sleep.

She craves the relief of a man who steps in to fix the leak,

To feel the comfort of support, to be allowed to just be weak.

​But the coin in his hand does not look like love.

It looks like a master’s chain.

How do you accept an umbrella from the man who summoned the rain?

Her principles rise up, rigid and cruel in her defense.

She cannot take his money without swallowing her soul,

She cannot buy her comfort by paying his hidden toll.

​It is a terrible, lonely curse to be a woman made of self-respect.

She wants the help so badly, she could weep on the open floor,

But her hands refuse to reach for the charity at the door.

She will fix the broken seals with her own bleeding hands,

Starving in her sovereignty, exactly where she stands.

Khuddari Aur Khairat
Kabir ke dohe gungunati hui badi hui thi woh,

Ek sookhi, par oonchi anaa pe khadi hui thi woh.

Kyunki duniya jab madad karti hai, toh keemat rooh ki maangti hai

Ghar ki chhat tapak rahi hai, deewaron par silan ka raaj hai.

​Kal tak jo humari kamayi se ghar chala raha tha,

Aaj woh meri bebasi par mujhe khairat baantne chala hai.

Dil cheekh kar kehta hai, bas ab aur bojh mat utha.

Ek pal ko lagta hai uske diye hue paise rakh loon,

Is toote hue aashiyane ki bikharti neev kass loon.

Zaroorat aur usoolon ki is khaufnaak jung mein,

Jism rehm ki bheekh mangta hai,

par zameer baghawat kar deta hai

Faake manzoor hain,

tapakti chhat manzoor hai, par uski reham ki bheekh nahi.
